project: Billing Plans — Rename Tiers + Monthly-to-Yearly Switch
description: Rename subscription plans from Free/Starter/Pro/Business to Free/Basic/Pro/Ultra. Add backend endpoint for existing subscribers to switch from monthly to yearly billing. Update frontend billing page and website pricing page to match.

context.currentProblem: Database has plans named Free/Starter/Pro/Business but user wants Free/Basic/Pro/Ultra. No backend endpoint exists for switching an existing subscription from monthly to yearly (current checkout creates NEW subscriptions instead of updating existing ones). Website pricing page and app billing page both reference old plan names.
context.desiredState: 4 plan tiers (Free, Basic, Pro, Ultra) each with monthly + yearly variants. Existing monthly subscribers can switch to yearly via in-app button (Stripe subscription update, not new checkout). All UI surfaces show correct plan names.
context.architectureGoal: Minimal changes. BillingModule is in apps/api (Platform Backend on Vercel) per backend-separation. Stripe webhook already handles subscription.updated events. Frontend billing page already has monthly/annual toggle.

decisions.backendLocation: apps/api (Platform Backend) — BillingModule stays here per backend-separation PRD
decisions.switchMethod: stripe.subscriptions.update() to change price ID — NOT a new checkout session (which would create duplicate subscriptions)
decisions.planNaming: Slugs follow pattern: {tier}-{interval} e.g. basic-monthly, basic-annual, pro-monthly, pro-annual, ultra-monthly, ultra-annual. Free plan has no interval variant (just 'free')
decisions.stripeSync: Stripe products/prices must be created manually in Stripe Dashboard. Price IDs stored in subscription_plans.stripe_price_id column. This is a manual step after DB migration.
decisions.websiteUpdate: Website pricing page (apps/website) has hardcoded plan data — rename Starter→Basic, Business→Ultra there too

currentDatabaseState.note: stripe_price_id is NULL for all plans — needs to be set after creating Stripe products

Slug 'starter-monthly' renamed to 'basic-monthly'
Slug 'starter-annual' renamed to 'basic-annual'
Plan named 'Business' renamed to 'Ultra' (both monthly and annual rows)

userStories.title: Add switch-interval endpoint to billing backend
userStories.description: Add POST /api/billing/switch-interval endpoint that uses stripe.subscriptions.update() to change an existing subscription's price from monthly to yearly (or yearly to monthly). Updates DB record with new plan_id and period.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/billing/switch-interval endpoint exists in billing.controller.ts
Accepts body: { targetInterval: 'month' | 'year' }
Looks up user's current subscription + plan from DB
Finds the matching plan with same tier but target interval (e.g., pro-monthly → pro-annual)
Calls stripe.subscriptions.update() with new price_id and proration_behavior: 'create_prorations'
Updates user_subscriptions row: plan_id, current_period_start, current_period_end
Returns { success: true, newPlan: { name, slug, interval, price_amount } }
Returns error if user has no active subscription
Returns error if target plan has no stripe_price_id configured
Returns error if already on target interval
Protected by AuthGuard and ThrottlerGuard
TypeScript compiles without errors
userStories.notes: stripe.subscriptions.update() handles proration automatically. The existing webhook handler (customer.subscription.updated) will also fire and update the DB, but we update immediately for responsiveness. Method goes in stripe.service.ts as switchSubscriptionInterval(). Controller in billing.controller.ts.
